member: Kofi — Structural Enclosure and Low-Cost Fabrication Specialist
message:
Surya, Lena, Farah, the raised concrete base still carries the full store with wide margin where plinth means flat concrete base spreading load to soil.
Plain words, produce plus box weigh little more than a small car on a patio slab.
Numbers are 2.45 kPa floor load from produce alone (E48) and 2.51 kPa soil pressure under plinth (E47), far below 50 kPa soil capacity from the generic slab guide (E43), sane against one person per square metre.
Lena, Farah, foam walls carry no crate load because steel corners and free-standing racks carry separately where Polyurethane (PU) means rigid foam insulation and Photovoltaic (PV) means solar panels.
Plain words, thin steel corners plus foam panels carry wind while crates stand on the base.
Numbers are 10 to 14 kg per square metre panels from the PU panel weight (E37) and 1.80 kg per metre angles from the steel angle weight (E40) for the 2.00 by 2.00 by 2.20 m box from the steady cooling load (E24), arranged as in the structure sketch (E49), sane against furniture a few people can lift.
Farah, people and crates still pass with low lifts through one door.
Plain words, low side racks keep lifts below shoulder height with gaps for air and mopping.
Numbers are 900 mm door and 100 mm wall gap from the interior plan (E36), sane against a household doorway. Not ready, because batch chiller watts with Lena and night cover with Surya must still close the blocking batch objection.
